006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.constraint.IFeatureValueConstrained;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
010
011import java.util.Locale;
012
013import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
014import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
015
016/**
017 * Represents a definition of a flag, field, or assembly in a Metaschema module.
018 * <p>
019 * Definitions are reusable components that specify the structure and
020 * constraints for data elements. They can be referenced by instances or defined
021 * inline.
022 */
023public interface IDefinition extends INamedModelElement, IAttributable, IFeatureValueConstrained {
024  /**
025   * Describes the visibility of a definition to other modules.
026   */
027  enum ModuleScope {
028    /**
029     * The definition is scoped to only the defining module.
030     */
031    PRIVATE,
032    /**
033     * The definition is scoped to its defining module and any importing module.
034     */
035    PUBLIC;
036  }
037
038  /**
039   * The default module scope for definitions.
040   */
041  @NonNull
042  ModuleScope DEFAULT_MODULE_SCOPE = ModuleScope.PUBLIC;
043
044  /**
045   * Retrieve the definition's scope within the context of its defining module.
046   *
047   * @return the module scope
048   */
049  @NonNull
050  default ModuleScope getModuleScope() {
051    return ModuleScope.PRIVATE;
052  }
053
054  /**
055   * The qualified name for the definition.
056   * <p>
057   * This name is the combination of the definition's namespace, which is the
058   * module's namespace, and the definition's name.
059   *
060   * @return the definition's qualified name
061   */
062  @NonNull
063  IEnhancedQName getDefinitionQName();
064
065  /**
066   * Determine if the definition is defined inline, meaning the definition is
067   * declared where it is used.
068   * <p>
069   * If this method returns {@code false}, then {@link #getInlineInstance()} must
070   * return {@code null}.
071   *
072   * @return {@code true} if the definition is declared inline or {@code false} if
073   *         the definition is able to be globally referenced
074   * @see #getInlineInstance()
075   */
076  default boolean isInline() {
077    return getInlineInstance() != null;
078  }
079
080  /**
081   * If {@link #isInline()} is {@code true}, return the instance the definition is
082   * inlined for.
083   * <p>
084   * If this method returns {@code null}, then {@link #getInlineInstance()} must
085   * return {@code false}.
086   *
087   * @return the instance or {@code null} otherwise
088   * @see #isInline()
089   */
090  INamedInstance getInlineInstance();
091
092  /**
093   * Generates a coordinate string for the provided information element
094   * definition.
095   *
096   * A coordinate consists of the element's:
097   * <ul>
098   * <li>containing Metaschema's short name
099   * <li>model type
100   * <li>name
101   * <li>hash code
102   * </ul>
103   *
104   * @return the coordinate
105   */
106  @SuppressWarnings("null")
107  @Override
108  default String toCoordinates() {
109    return String.format("%s:%s-definition:%s(%d)",
110        getContainingModule().getShortName(),
111        getModelType().toString().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT),
112        getName(),
113        hashCode());
114  }
115
116  /**
117   * Get the resource location information for the provided item, if known.
118   *
119   * @param itemValue
120   *          the item to get the location information for
121   *
122   * @return the resource location information, or {@code null} if not known
123   */
124  @Nullable
125  default IResourceLocation getLocation(@NonNull Object itemValue) {
126    return itemValue instanceof IBoundObject ? ((IBoundObject) itemValue).getMetaschemaData() : null;
127  }
128}
